explanation: Rearrange a copy of the array so every value v in 1 through n occupies index v−1 when present. Ignore out-of-range values and already placed duplicates. The first misplaced index gives the missing positive.
timeComplexity: O(n) time: each swap fixes one value’s position.
spaceComplexity: O(n) space for the copied value parameter; O(1) further auxiliary space.
